description: clrin: take in the networks' clearing file
reads the night's clearing file, checks it is for the business date the
run is given, and checks each acquirer's batch against its trailer: the
presentments of a batch whose count and amount agree go on to matching,
those of a batch that does not are rejected whole. a presentment that
does not validate is rejected alone, but counts towards its batch. the
file trailer's totals are checked last.
return codes: 0 all taken, 4 some rejected, 8 file totals differ,
12 not the night's file, 16 cannot read or write.
2014-02-17 rk  lcs-0251 presentments held until their batch checks.

records.name: CLR-FILE-HEADER
records.description: clrrec: the networks' clearing file, a record a line, of five layouts told apart by their first two characters. A file header, then for each acquirer's batch a batch header, its presentments and a batch trailer with their count and amount, then a file trailer with the batches', the presentments' and the amounts' totals. history 2011-04-04 rk  lcs-0102 original version. 2016-09-12 ah  lcs-0377 card product on the presentment.

records.name: PRES-RECORD
records.description: presrec: a presentment on its way through the night, a record a line. clrin fills in where it came from, match its authorization's outcome, ixfee the interchange fee. history 2011-04-04 rk  lcs-0102 original version. 2014-02-17 rk  lcs-0251 match status and interchange fee.

paragraphs.name: TAKE-BATCH
paragraphs.description: a batch: its header, its presentments held until its trailer, which lets them go on or rejects them all. the held presentments pass through the file's record, so the trailer read is set aside meanwhile.
